answer: Sybil crews can still park many grader keys on one porch and take every open seat. A claimant must wander the 220 m towpath from lock 4 to the stone bridge, then press a pocket mirror against the keystone benchmark for a 14-second reflection that encodes a 7-digit path ticket. The ticket bond is 29 coins, one ticket per address, held 8 hours. Peers clock the walk within 11 minutes, recover the ticket from the reflection, and confirm it with the registrar. A reused ticket, a shortcut off the towpath, or a garbled reflection voids the seat and burns the 29 coins.
